angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 548,212 km at 154.20 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.4849 +/- 0.0113 mas (same row, RUWE 0.84): 154.20 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.788 +/- 0.017 solar radii from Yee et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-3486 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..280...30Y/abstract): 548,212 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.837 +/- 0.037 solar masses from Yee et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-3486 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..280...30Y/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4930 +/- 120 K from Yee et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-3486 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..280...30Y/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Yee et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-3486 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..280...30Y/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-3486.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.568, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-3486: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-3486 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.283 dex, from Yee et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..280...30Y/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-3486 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.4828, from Yee et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..280...30Y/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-3486 (pscomppars): age 5.8 Gyr, from Yee et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..280...30Y/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
